module: Flowgraph node "Get Object Field" (repeat_instant). Reads a field of a scene object (scenetree.findObjectById). Inputs: objectId, fieldName, fieldArrayNum (optional, 0 by default, hidden). Output: value (any). Uses getField if the field is declared, otherwise getDynDataFieldbyName (dynamic field).
notes: Nothing is written if the object is not found: the output keeps its old value.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Finds the object, then writes value with obj:getField(name, index) if the name is in obj:getFields(), otherwise with obj:getDynDataFieldbyName.
